notes.title: May's Update is out now!
notes.notes:
Another update is out now. This time we focused mostly on fixing some issues we have discovered recently. And we have also added new race with cool abilities to the Sandbox mode.

Features:

new race is now available in Sandbox mode
Spacebar and Esc keys are now binded with actions (Esc - close window/open settings window; Spacebar - End Turn)
minor HUD changes


Fixes:

offline friends are not shown in friends list anymore
another fix for multiplayer invites
minor UI issues fixed 


We hope that you have a great time playing the game, Admirals!

notes.title: Hotfix for April's Update
notes.notes:
We found out that there were problems with creating save directory and launching the game (white screen issue). It is fixed now and should work properly for all platforms.

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: April's Update is out now!
notes.notes:
We are glad to announce another update and this time it is global!

New features:

 New race is available for both single campaign and multiplayer
 9 new ships with some absolutetly new abilities
 15 new campaign missions


Fixed issues:

 fixed minor UI issues
 fixed the issue when player could accidentaly click on wrong level in level select screen
 issue with pause during single campaign is fixed
 multiplayer invites are now working properly
 player status is now shown in friends list

notes.title: New multiplayer update!
